notes:
Summary: Mid-market SaaS product team. Completed 3-week Hosted API trial; team satisfied with latency and quality. Now evaluating Dedicated for predictable throughput and data isolation. POC goal: validate steady-state QPS, peak concurrency behavior, and token-unit economics tied to UI flows.

Trial findings (hosted API):
- Avg request profile: 0.65 QPS sustained across telemetry during business hours; baseline 12 QPS simulated on demo day.
- Token mix: avg prompt 85 tokens, avg completion 220 tokens; 70% short intents (<=200 tokens), 20% long context retrievals (>=1,500 tokens), 10% embeddings/rerank calls.
- 95th pct latency: 360ms for simple chat paths; 900–1,600ms for long-context generation (acceptable but want <1s most of the time).
- Cost sensitivity: product-led growth; cost per MAU important — customer expects ~30% improvement vs current hosted over scale.

Quotes/paraphrases: "We liked the streaming behavior and the SDK — quicker dev turnaround." — Head of Product. "Will need stronger guarantees around throughput for drop-in replacement." — Eng mgr.

Technical constraints / requirements:
- Need VPC peering and private routing; can't send PII to third-party logs.
- KMS integration mandatory, audit logs for model calls retained 1 year.
- Residency: primary data must stay in NA region.

Dedicated sizing ask (current request):
- Target steady-state QPS: 20 QPS (business hours), expected baseline 12–15.
- Peak burst QPS: 80–120 QPS (marketing events / product launch windows).
- Peak concurrency target: 30–40 concurrent streams for chat (streaming responses).
- Token throughput target: 2.5M tokens/day initially; scale plan to 10M tokens/day over 12 months.
- Desired latency SLO: p99 < 1.2s for chat; p95 < 600ms for short intents.

Billing / pricing notes:
- Interested in committed monthly capacity with burst credits. Ask: what commit level maps to expected QPS + token mix? Requesting cost model scenarios (4 commit levels).

POC plan / timeline:
- Week 0: Dedicated sizing workshop + network config checklist.
- Week 1–2: Private VPC setup + sample routing policy for fallback to hosted.
- Week 3–4: Load-run POC (ramp to 120 QPS ephemeral) + tracing/observability review.
- Week 5: Review, pricing term negotiation, procurement paperwork.

Artifacts & refs: pricing deck (drive), hosted-trial logs (GCS stub), Fireflies recording of 2026-03-04 demo.
